integrity: The stated infinite point-count and zeta identities follow from the seven explicit singularities, nonsplit tangent cones and two-step A3 resolution; independent mathematical validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem applies to this explicit F2 model and its minimal smooth resolution, not to all seven-A3 quartics. The Artin invariant and integral Neron-Severi lattice are not computed. Finite checker tests n=1,...,6 only; the all-n argument is algebraic.
title: Exact zeta function of a seven-\(A_3\) Klein quartic K3 surface over \(\mathbb F_2\)
